T-213 is in review. The warm-up job waits on Tantra, the worker is deployed and the lead email works. I did not push, because local main and `origin/main` have diverged.

decisions.decision: Do not use the Instantly key. Instantly is ruled out, and Endy's process is already known from Adi's 2026-10-07 message and their site. Claude now: (1) in cloud/src/agentic.ts:25 and 460-519 and jobs.ts:564-566, change the start-endy flow to wait for the inboxes in Tantra Accounts (Connected and Gmail capable) instead of Instantly. Add a probe that proves cloud/src has no Instantly references. (2) Build the default hand-off: the centre sends one email per new Inbox Partner Leads row to a configurable ENDY_LEAD_EMAIL. Until Endy gives an address, send it to a team inbox. Also keep a view-only sheet share as a fallback. (3) Write a test row and confirm it is delivered. (4) Write Nelbin a one-page call brief: the hand-off, a proposed 20% recurring revenue share, delivery into Tantra through the service-account client ID and the 3 scopes (never Instantly), pricing and turnaround. Nelbin holds the call and records the agreement in the task log.
decisions.why: Instantly is banned under approved-vendor-stack. Escalating the fetch question breaks orchestrator-autonomy. Spec item (a) lets Claude wire the email hand-off. The Endy call is an outside conversation that Nelbin, the Ops owner, runs. Adi isn't needed.
